resources.string: Shop by voice, for the blind
Tap to talk. Speak what you want to buy.
Type what you want to buy
Type what you want to buy, then send
Scan a barcode with the camera
Point the camera at something and ask what it is
Things you bought before, buy them again
Items you asked me to watch for a price drop
What deals do my favorite stores have today
Daily roundup of price drops on your list
Settings, language, location and your data
Say what you want to buy, or tap Scan barcode.
We found %1$d results. Here are the top three.
We found %1$d results. Here are the next three.
Nothing found for that. Try different words.
Open this item at %1$s. The store opens in your browser.
Add this item to my shopping list
Remember this item and tell me when the price drops
AIN Shop only helps with shopping. What do you want to buy?
Too many searches just now. Please wait a little and try again.
No internet right now. Please check your connection and try again.
That search is taking a while. Here is what I found so far.
Voice listening is not available on this phone right now.
I need the microphone to hear you. Please allow it.
I didn\'t hear that. Please say it again.
Shall I open this at %1$s so you can buy it there?
Delete %1$s? Say yes to delete, or no to keep it.

You can say: shop for shoes, scan barcode, what is this, my list, buy again, watch this price, what dropped today, deals today, stores near me, fastest delivery, track my order, go to Walmart, or stop.
Hold the barcode to the camera. I will beep faster when I see stripes, and chime when I read it.
Not in the free product databases. I will not guess what it is.
Those digits are not a valid product barcode. A digit was probably misread.
I need the camera to scan. Please allow it.
Point the camera at it and tap Take photo. I will tell you what it is.
Take a photo and ask what it is
I could not tell what that is from the photo. Try again with more light.
Your shopping list is empty. Say “add milk to my list”.
Nothing in Buy again yet. When you open a store page, it is remembered here.
Search for this again to buy it
Nothing watched yet. After a search, say “remember this item”.
Check all watched items for price drops now
Price drop! %1$s is now %2$s at %3$s. It was %4$s.
No price drops. %1$d watched items are the same price.
I could not find %1$s just now.
Thanks, I remembered that on this phone.
%1$s is now one of your favorites. I will check it first from now on.
AIN Shop does not see your orders. I open the store\'s own page. You may need to sign in there.
May I use your location to find stores near you? I only keep your ZIP code or town, on this phone.
That is fine. You can type a ZIP code instead.
Once a day, check watched items and tell me if a price dropped. Off unless you turn it on.
Delete AIN Shop data on this phone
AIN Shop has no account. This erases your language, lists, Buy again history, ZIP code and settings from this phone.

AIN Shop does not ask for your name, email or phone number. Your voice is not recorded or kept. Prices come from stores and the web and can be wrong — the store\'s page is final. Some store links are affiliate links; AIN Shop may earn a commission. Your price stays the same.
Mistakes you reported, kept on this phone only. Nothing is sent anywhere. A person reviews them before any fix is made.
Your phone\'s own hearing does not cover %1$s. I can download a small listening model (about 75 MB) over Wi-Fi, once, so I can still hear you. It stays on your phone.
